36	    fun isLastUpdateCheckExpired(expiry: Long): Boolean {
37	        return Instant.ofEpochSecond(expiry) < Instant.now()

40	    /**
41	     * Coerce expiry date time in between 6 hours and 72 hours from now
42	     *
43	     * @return Epoch second of expiry date time
44	     */
45	    fun coerceUpdateCheckExpiry(expiryString: String?): Long {
46	        val nowPlus6Hours = ZonedDateTime.now().plusHours(6)

48	            ZonedDateTime.from(DateTimeFormatter.RFC_1123_DATE_TIME.parse(it))

50	        } ?: nowPlus6Hours
51	        return expiry.toEpochSecond()
52	    }

18	    /**
19	     * #143 #44 #42 #22: make sure that the filename does not contain illegal chars.

21	     * @param context the context to retrieve strings and preferences from
22	     * @param title the title to create a filename from

24	     */
25	    @JvmStatic
26	    fun createFilename(context: Context, title: String): String {
27	        val sharedPreferences = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
28	
29	        val charsetLd = context.getString(R.string.charset_letters_and_digits_value)
30	        val charsetMs = context.getString(R.string.charset_most_special_value)
31	        val defaultCharset = context.getString(R.string.default_file_charset_value)
32	
33	        val replacementChar = sharedPreferences.getStringSafe(
34	            context.getString(R.string.settings_file_replacement_character_key),
35	            "_"
36	        )
37	        val selectedCharset = sharedPreferences.getStringSafe(
38	            context.getString(R.string.settings_file_charset_key),
39	            ""
40	        ).ifEmpty { defaultCharset }
41	
42	        val charset = when (selectedCharset) {
43	            charsetLd -> CHARSET_ONLY_LETTERS_AND_DIGITS
44	            charsetMs -> CHARSET_MOST_SPECIAL
45	            else -> selectedCharset // Is the user using a custom charset?
46	        }
47	
48	        return createFilename(title, charset, Matcher.quoteReplacement(replacementChar))
49	    }

51	    /**

55	     * @param invalidCharacters patter matching invalid characters

50	tailrec fun Throwable?.hasCause(checkSubtypes: Boolean, vararg causesToCheck: Class<*>): Boolean {
51	    if (this == null) {
52	        return false
53	    }
54	
55	    // Check if throwable is a subtype of any of the causes to check
56	    causesToCheck.forEach { causeClass ->
57	        if (checkSubtypes) {
58	            if (causeClass.isAssignableFrom(this.javaClass)) {
59	                return true
60	            }
61	        } else if (causeClass == this.javaClass) {
62	            return true
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    val currentCause: Throwable? = cause
67	    // Check if cause is not pointing to the same instance, to avoid infinite loops.
68	    if (this !== currentCause) {
69	        return currentCause.hasCause(checkSubtypes, *causesToCheck)
70	    }
71	
72	    return false
73	}

26	 * - Use a notification if the exception happens inside a background service (player, subscription
27	 *      import, ...) or there is no activity/fragment from which to extract a root view.
28	 * - Finally use the error activity only as a last resort in case the exception is critical and
29	 *      happens in an open activity (since the workflow would be interrupted anyway in that case).
30	 */
31	class ErrorUtil {
32	    companion object {
33	        private const val ERROR_REPORT_NOTIFICATION_ID = 5340681
34	
35	        /**
36	         * Starts a new error activity allowing the user to report the provided error. Only use this
37	         * method directly as a last resort in case the exception is critical and happens in an open
38	         * activity (since the workflow would be interrupted anyway in that case). So never use this
39	         * for background services.
40	         *
41	         * If the crashed occurred while the app was in the background open a notification instead
42	         *
43	         * @param context the context to use to start the new activity
44	         * @param errorInfo the error info to be reported
45	         */
46	        @JvmStatic
47	        fun openActivity(context: Context, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
48	            if (PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
49	                    .getBoolean(MainActivity.KEY_IS_IN_BACKGROUND, true)
50	            ) {
51	                createNotification(context, errorInfo)
52	            } else {
53	                context.startActivity(getErrorActivityIntent(context, errorInfo))
54	            }
55	        }
56	
57	        /**
58	         * Show a bottom snackbar to the user, with a report button that opens the error activity.
59	         * Use this method if the exception is not critical and it happens in a place where a root
60	         * view is available.
61	         *
62	         * @param context will be used to obtain the root view if it is an [Activity]; if no root
63	         *                view can be found an error notification is shown instead
64	         * @param errorInfo the error info to be reported
65	         */
66	        @JvmStatic
67	        fun showSnackbar(context: Context, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
68	            val rootView = (context as? Activity)?.findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content)
69	            showSnackbar(context, rootView, errorInfo)
70	        }
71	
72	        /**
73	         * Show a bottom snackbar to the user, with a report button that opens the error activity.
74	         * Use this method if the exception is not critical and it happens in a place where a root
75	         * view is available.
76	         *
77	         * @param fragment will be used to obtain the root view if it has a connected [Activity]; if
78	         *                 no root view can be found an error notification is shown instead
79	         * @param errorInfo the error info to be reported
80	         */
81	        @JvmStatic
82	        fun showSnackbar(fragment: Fragment, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
83	            var rootView = fragment.view
84	            if (rootView == null && fragment.activity != null) {
85	                rootView = fragment.requireActivity().findViewById(android.R.id.content)
86	            }
87	            showSnackbar(fragment.requireContext(), rootView, errorInfo)
88	        }
89	
90	        /**
91	         * Shortcut to calling [showSnackbar] with an [ErrorInfo] of type [UserAction.UI_ERROR]
92	         */
93	        @JvmStatic
94	        fun showUiErrorSnackbar(context: Context, request: String, throwable: Throwable) {
95	            showSnackbar(context, ErrorInfo(throwable, UserAction.UI_ERROR, request))
96	        }
97	
98	        /**
99	         * Shortcut to calling [showSnackbar] with an [ErrorInfo] of type [UserAction.UI_ERROR]
100	         */
101	        @JvmStatic
102	        fun showUiErrorSnackbar(fragment: Fragment, request: String, throwable: Throwable) {
103	            showSnackbar(fragment, ErrorInfo(throwable, UserAction.UI_ERROR, request))
104	        }
105	
106	        /**
107	         * Create an error notification. Tapping on the notification opens the error activity. Use
108	         * this method if the exception happens inside a background service (player, subscription
109	         * import, ...) or there is no activity/fragment from which to extract a root view.
110	         *
111	         * @param context the context to use to show the notification
112	         * @param errorInfo the error info to be reported; the error message
113	         *                  [ErrorInfo.messageStringId] will be shown in the notification
114	         *                  description
115	         */
116	        @JvmStatic
117	        fun createNotification(context: Context, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
118	            val notificationBuilder: NotificationCompat.Builder =
119	                NotificationCompat.Builder(
120	                    context,
121	                    context.getString(R.string.error_report_channel_id)
122	                )
123	                    .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_bug_report)
124	                    .setContentTitle(context.getString(R.string.error_report_notification_title))
125	                    .setContentText(errorInfo.getMessage(context))
126	                    .setAutoCancel(true)
127	                    .setContentIntent(
128	                        PendingIntentCompat.getActivity(
129	                            context,
130	                            0,
131	                            getErrorActivityIntent(context, errorInfo),
132	                            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT,
133	                            false
134	                        )
135	                    )
136	
137	            val notificationManager = NotificationManagerCompat.from(context)
138	            if (notificationManager.areNotificationsEnabled()) {
139	                notificationManager
140	                    .notify(ERROR_REPORT_NOTIFICATION_ID, notificationBuilder.build())
141	            }
142	
143	            ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(context).execute {
144	                // since the notification is silent, also show a toast, otherwise the user is confused
145	                Toast.makeText(context, R.string.error_report_notification_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT)
146	                    .show()
147	            }
148	        }
149	
150	        private fun getErrorActivityIntent(context: Context, errorInfo: ErrorInfo): Intent {
151	            val intent = Intent(context, ErrorActivity::class.java)
152	            intent.putExtra(ErrorActivity.ERROR_INFO, errorInfo)
153	            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
154	            return intent
155	        }
156	
157	        private fun showSnackbar(context: Context, rootView: View?, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
158	            if (rootView == null) {
159	                // fallback to showing a notification if no root view is available
160	                createNotification(context, errorInfo)
161	            } else {
162	                Snackbar.make(rootView, errorInfo.getMessage(context), Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG)
163	                    .setActionTextColor(Color.YELLOW)
164	                    .setAction(context.getString(R.string.error_snackbar_action).uppercase()) {
165	                        context.startActivity(getErrorActivityIntent(context, errorInfo))
166	                    }.show()
167	            }
168	        }
169	    }
170	}

36	 * to report the error and to show it to the user along with correct action buttons.
37	 */

41	    val userAction: UserAction,
42	    val request: String,
43	    val serviceId: Int?,
44	    private val message: ErrorMessage,
45	    /**
46	     * If `true`, a report button will be shown for this error. Otherwise the error is not something

48	     */
49	    val isReportable: Boolean,

52	     */

54	    /**

90	        serviceId: Int? = null,

92	    ) : this(
93	        throwableListToStringList(throwables),
94	        userAction,
95	        request,
96	        serviceId,
97	        getMessage(throwables.firstOrNull(), userAction, serviceId),

129	        userAction: UserAction,

131	        info: Info?
132	    ) :
133	        this(throwables, userAction, request, info?.serviceId, info?.url)

143	    companion object {
144	        @Parcelize
145	        class ErrorMessage(
146	            @StringRes
147	            private val stringRes: Int,
148	            private vararg val formatArgs: String
149	        ) : Parcelable {
150	            fun getText(context: Context): CharSequence {
151	                // Ensure locale aware context via ContextCompat.getContextForLanguage() (just in case context is not AppCompatActivity)
152	                val ctx = ContextCompat.getContextForLanguage(context)
153	                return if (formatArgs.isEmpty()) {
154	                    ctx.getText(stringRes)
155	                } else {
156	                    // ContextCompat.getString() with formatArgs does not exist, so we just
157	                    // replicate its source code but with formatArgs
158	                    ctx.resources.getText(stringRes, *formatArgs)
159	                }
160	            }
161	        }
162	
163	        const val SERVICE_NONE = "<unknown_service>"
164	
165	        const val YOUTUBE_IP_BAN_FAQ_URL = "https://newpipe.net/FAQ/#ip-banned-youtube"
166	
167	        private fun getServiceName(serviceId: Int?) = // not using getNameOfServiceById since we want to accept a nullable serviceId and we
168	            // want to default to SERVICE_NONE
169	            ServiceList.all().firstOrNull { it.serviceId == serviceId }?.serviceInfo?.name
170	                ?: SERVICE_NONE
171	
172	        fun throwableToStringList(throwable: Throwable) = arrayOf(throwable.stackTraceToString())
173	
174	        fun throwableListToStringList(throwableList: List<Throwable>) = throwableList.map { it.stackTraceToString() }.toTypedArray()
175	
176	        fun getMessage(
177	            throwable: Throwable?,
178	            action: UserAction?,
179	            serviceId: Int?
180	        ): ErrorMessage {
181	            return when {
182	                // player exceptions
183	                // some may be IOException, so do these checks before isNetworkRelated!
184	                throwable is ExoPlaybackException -> {
185	                    val cause = throwable.cause
186	                    when {
187	                        cause is HttpDataSource.InvalidResponseCodeException -> {
188	                            if (cause.responseCode == 403) {
189	                                if (serviceId == YouTube.serviceId) {
190	                                    ErrorMessage(R.string.youtube_player_http_403)
191	                                } else {
192	                                    ErrorMessage(R.string.player_http_403)
193	                                }
194	                            } else {
195	                                ErrorMessage(R.string.player_http_invalid_status, cause.responseCode.toString())
196	                            }
197	                        }
198	
199	                        cause is Loader.UnexpectedLoaderException && cause.cause is ExtractionException ->
200	                            getMessage(throwable, action, serviceId)
201	
202	                        throwable.type == ExoPlaybackException.TYPE_SOURCE ->
203	                            ErrorMessage(R.string.player_stream_failure)
204	
205	                        throwable.type == ExoPlaybackException.TYPE_UNEXPECTED ->
206	                            ErrorMessage(R.string.player_recoverable_failure)
207	
208	                        else ->
209	                            ErrorMessage(R.string.player_unrecoverable_failure)
210	                    }
211	                }
212	
213	                throwable is FailedMediaSource.FailedMediaSourceException ->
214	                    getMessage(throwable.cause, action, serviceId)
215	
216	                throwable is PlaybackResolver.ResolverException ->
217	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.player_stream_failure)
218	
219	                // content not available exceptions
220	                throwable is AccountTerminatedException ->
221	                    throwable.message
222	                        ?.takeIf { reason -> !reason.isEmpty() }
223	                        ?.let { reason ->
224	                            ErrorMessage(
225	                                R.string.account_terminated_service_provides_reason,
226	                                getServiceName(serviceId),
227	                                reason
228	                            )
229	                        }
230	                        ?: ErrorMessage(R.string.account_terminated)
231	
232	                throwable is AgeRestrictedContentException ->
233	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.restricted_video_no_stream)
234	
235	                throwable is GeographicRestrictionException ->
236	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.georestricted_content)
237	
238	                throwable is PaidContentException ->
239	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.paid_content)
240	
241	                throwable is PrivateContentException ->
242	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.private_content)
243	
244	                throwable is SoundCloudGoPlusContentException ->
245	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.soundcloud_go_plus_content)
246	
247	                throwable is UnsupportedContentInCountryException ->
248	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.unsupported_content_in_country)
249	
250	                throwable is YoutubeMusicPremiumContentException ->
251	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.youtube_music_premium_content)
252	
253	                throwable is SignInConfirmNotBotException ->
254	                    ErrorMessage(
255	                        R.string.sign_in_confirm_not_bot_error,
256	                        getServiceName(serviceId),
257	                        YOUTUBE_IP_BAN_FAQ_URL
258	                    )
259	
260	                throwable is ContentNotAvailableException ->
261	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.content_not_available)
262	
263	                // other extractor exceptions
264	                throwable is ContentNotSupportedException ->
265	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.content_not_supported)
266	
267	                // ReCaptchas will be handled in a special way anyway
268	                throwable is ReCaptchaException ->
269	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.recaptcha_request_toast)
270	
271	                // test this at the end as many exceptions could be a subclass of IOException
272	                throwable != null && throwable.isNetworkRelated ->
273	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.network_error)
274	
275	                // an extraction exception unrelated to the network
276	                // is likely an issue with parsing the website
277	                throwable is ExtractionException ->
278	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.parsing_error)
279	
280	                // user actions (in case the exception is null or unrecognizable)
281	                action == UserAction.UI_ERROR ->
282	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.app_ui_crash)
283	
284	                action == UserAction.REQUESTED_COMMENTS ->
285	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.error_unable_to_load_comments)
286	
287	                action == UserAction.SUBSCRIPTION_CHANGE ->
288	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.subscription_change_failed)
289	
290	                action == UserAction.SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATE ->
291	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.subscription_update_failed)
292	
293	                action == UserAction.LOAD_IMAGE ->
294	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.could_not_load_thumbnails)
295	
296	                action == UserAction.DOWNLOAD_OPEN_DIALOG ->
297	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.could_not_setup_download_menu)
298	
299	                else ->
300	                    ErrorMessage(R.string.error_snackbar_message)
301	            }
302	        }
303	
304	        fun isReportable(throwable: Throwable?): Boolean {
305	            return when (throwable) {
306	                // we don't have an exception, so this is a manually built error, which likely
307	                // indicates that it's important and is thus reportable
308	                null -> true
309	
310	                // if the service explicitly said that content is not available (e.g. age
311	                // restrictions, video deleted, etc.), there is no use in letting users report it
312	                is ContentNotAvailableException -> !isContentSurelyNotAvailable(throwable)
313	
314	                // we know the content is not supported, no need to let the user report it
315	                is ContentNotSupportedException -> false
316	
317	                // happens often when there is no internet connection; we don't use
318	                // `throwable.isNetworkRelated` since any `IOException` would make that function
319	                // return true, but not all `IOException`s are network related
320	                is UnknownHostException -> false
321	
322	                // by default, this is an unexpected exception, which the user could report
323	                else -> true
324	            }
325	        }
326	
327	        fun isRetryable(throwable: Throwable?): Boolean {
328	            return when (throwable) {
329	                // if we know the content is surely not available, retrying won't help
330	                is ContentNotAvailableException -> !isContentSurelyNotAvailable(throwable)
331	
332	                // we know the content is not supported, retrying won't help
333	                is ContentNotSupportedException -> false
334	
335	                // by default (including if throwable is null), enable retrying (though the retry
336	                // button will be shown only if a way to perform the retry is implemented)
337	                else -> true
338	            }
339	        }
340	
341	        /**
342	         * Unfortunately sometimes [ContentNotAvailableException] may not indicate that the content
343	         * is blocked/deleted/paid, but may just indicate that we could not extract it. This is an
344	         * inconsistency in the exceptions thrown by the extractor, but until it is fixed, this
345	         * function will distinguish between the two types.
346	         * @return `true` if the content is not available because of a limitation imposed by the
347	         * service or the owner, `false` if the extractor could not extract info about it
348	         */
349	        fun isContentSurelyNotAvailable(e: ContentNotAvailableException): Boolean {
350	            return when (e) {
351	                is AccountTerminatedException,
352	                is AgeRestrictedContentException,
353	                is GeographicRestrictionException,
354	                is PaidContentException,
355	                is PrivateContentException,
356	                is SoundCloudGoPlusContentException,
357	                is UnsupportedContentInCountryException,
358	                is YoutubeMusicPremiumContentException -> true
359	
360	                else -> false
361	            }
362	        }
363	    }
364	}

import androidx.interpolator.view.animation.FastOutSlowInInterpolator
import org.schabi.newpipe.MainActivity

private const val TAG = "TextViewUtils"

 *

 * @param colorStart the text color to start with
 * @param colorEnd   the text color to end with
 */
fun TextView.animateTextColor(duration: Long, @ColorInt colorStart: Int, @ColorInt colorEnd: Int) {
    if (MainActivity.DEBUG) {

    viewPropertyAnimator.interpolator = FastOutSlowInInterpolator()
    viewPropertyAnimator.duration = duration
    viewPropertyAnimator.addUpdateListener { setTextColor(it.animatedValue as Int) }
    viewPropertyAnimator.addListener(onCancel = { setTextColor(colorEnd) }, onEnd = { setTextColor(colorEnd) })
    viewPropertyAnimator.start()
}

fun TextView.animateTextColor(duration: Long, @ColorInt colorStart: Int, @ColorInt colorEnd: Int) {

    viewPropertyAnimator.interpolator = FastOutSlowInInterpolator()
    viewPropertyAnimator.duration = duration
    viewPropertyAnimator.addUpdateListener { setTextColor(it.animatedValue as Int) }
    viewPropertyAnimator.addListener(onCancel = { setTextColor(colorEnd) }, onEnd = { setTextColor(colorEnd) })
    viewPropertyAnimator.start()
}
